Accounting (ACCT)

Courses

ACCT 5003. Advanced Financial Accounting. 3 Hours.

Accounting for business combinations, consolidated statements, and partnerships, with an introduction to governmental accounting.

ACCT 5103. Auditing Standards and Practice. 3 Hours.

Generally accepted auditing standards, audit evidence and sampling, and the auditor's report on financial statements.

ACCT 5203. Federal Income Taxation of Entities. 3 Hours.

Taxation of corporations, partnerships, estates and trusts, with research in the primary sources of tax law.
